title: Red Hat Security Advisory: kernel security, bug fix, and enhancement update
description: This Red Hat Security Advisory addresses multiple critical vulnerabilities and bug fixes in the Linux kernel packages for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8.6. The update includes patches for several security issues such as improper list handling, missing RCU protection, out-of-bounds writes, denial of service, memory disclosure, and local privilege escalation. The advisory emphasizes the critical nature of these fixes due to the kernel's fundamental role in system security and recommends prompt application of the update and system reboot.
